channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from FMallSectionsDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: TikTok reaches $400 million settlement in children's privacy case
item.description: TikTok and ByteDance have agreed to pay $400 million to settle claims they violated children's online privacy laws.

item.title: To Lower Beef Prices, Trump Should Support Farmers in Expanding Herds
item.description: Rather than short-term fixes for beef prices before midterms, the administration should help farmers increase supply.

item.title: Protester at Trump rally wore shirt reading 'Kill Your Local Pedophile'
item.description: Two protesters were removed from a Trump rally in Myrtle Beach, one wearing a shirt with a provocative anti-pedophile message.

item.title: Leavitt to join Trump's super PAC after leaving White House
item.description: Former press secretary Karoline Leavitt will move to MAGA Inc., Trump's super PAC, after resigning from her White House role.
